{{Top|leg}}
'''O'in Tielord''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Trader's Guild]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], O'in Tiellord was sighted in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCivilian.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of O'in Tielord]]
O'in was identified as O'in Tielord in the game, but erroneously identified as '''O'in Tiellord''' in the SWG feature ''Star Chart: Endor System''.
